title: Produce provenance attestations for container builds
body:
I was talking to @adityasaky recently about provenance generation and we couldn't find any history of discussing its generation here.

Is there interest in supporting producing a SLSA provenance attestation when producing a container image or an OCI artifact? As a rule of thumb, the system that builds the artifact is best suited to attesting to its provenance, so buildah seems like a good fit. Buildx added experimental support for generating attestations some time ago: https://docs.docker.com/build/metadata/attestations/slsa-provenance.

If buildah starts to support this pattern, it could even be leveraged to improve the SBOM generation. Instead of just being able to merge SBOMs, potentially running some basic analysis to generate them, buildah could optionally allow additional instrumentation to support a system like [SBOMit](https://github.com/SBOMit) which generates SBOMs based on detailed [witness](https://github.com/in-toto/witness) attestations.

This latter conversation can be moved elsewhere (i.e. in a new issue), I just wanted to acknowledge the relationship that I see in my head. Is this a conversation that belongs in a different place altogether though?

References:
SLSA build provenance: https://slsa.dev/spec/v1.2/build-requirements
Prior art with buildx producing provenance: https://docs.docker.com/build/metadata/attestations/
